answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a lagoon as the anchor of the cost.
